next_step: Run 2-week POC on dev team; perf spike + auth integration
notes: Background: small team building a VS Code extension for distributed dev teams. Focus: fast inline suggestions + streaming completions to keep typing flow.
Prod constraints: must support ~120 concurrent active devs, 30k tokens/day initially, bursty sessions during syncs.

Latency targets: p50 <50ms for inline suggestion generation (local-ish hints), p95 <200ms for streaming completion during full-line/AI pair programming. Want sub-100ms single-token latency if possible.
Auth model: GitHub OAuth for install, but enterprise customers require SSO/SAML and SCIM provisioning. Interested in per-user API keys and short-lived tokens from Redwood.

Rate limits: customers expect per-org and per-user rate caps; want a model where IDE enforces client-side rate limiting and Redwood returns clear headers + quota endpoints. Concerned about noisy neighbors when multiple devs on same org trigger batch requests.

Model/version pinning: must be able to pin extension to a reproducible model hash for a channel (stable/canary). Also want automatic fallback to smaller quantized model on Dedicated if latency spikes.
Streaming: prefer WebSocket streaming for low-latency char-by-char, but fallback to SSE or chunked HTTP for corporate proxies. Need guidance on SDK reconnection/backoff strategy.
Privacy: extension will send code context snippets for completions. Requirement: option to redact PII and not store payloads beyond 24 hours, or route to Private deployment for enterprise customers.
POC scope agreed: integrate Redwood hosted API in extension, measure latency across devs in US/EU, validate streaming behavior + error handling, and exercise model pinning API. 2-week spike timeline.
Recent calls: 2025-01-28 demo with Maya (AE), Diego (SE) — showed streaming demo, asked for SDK spec and sample reconnect logic. Fireflies id ff_20250128_7a9c.
Security: sent initial security questionnaire 2025-01-30. Waiting on SOC2 type II and ISO27001 certs. They flagged KMS controls and retention policy as must-haves for procurement.
Quote from CTO: "We need completions to feel instant — anything over 150ms breaks the flow. Also, predictable per-dev billing is critical."

Technical notes: will instrument telemetry in extension to capture token counts per session, latency histogram, and error rate. Wants token-cost estimation API from Redwood Optimize to predict monthly spend.
Implementation preferences: lightweight JS SDK for VS Code extension (node), server-side relay for enterprise installs to manage secrets and rate-limits, prefer sample repo + quickstart.
Commercial: interested in monthly committed spend for Dedicated once POC meets SLAs; initial estimate $30k/year, uplift if private deployment requested.
Next logistics: SE to ship sample extension repo and reconnect/backoff example by 2025-02-07. AE to provide draft pricing and Dedicated sizing by 2025-02-10.
